title: [PM-40693] Hide copy button on file Sends
body:
## 🎟️ Tracking

<!-- Paste the link to the Jira or GitHub issue or otherwise describe / point to where this change is coming from. -->
https://bitwarden.atlassian.net/browse/PM-40693

## 📔 Objective

<!-- Describe what the purpose of this PR is, for example what bug you're fixing or new feature you're adding. -->
This PR fixes a bug where the "Make a Copy" button was incorrectly displayed for File Sends, which can't be copied. It also fixes two unrelated bugs, one that would incorrectly show the "Send is Disabled" banner after the "Make a Copy" button was pressed on the browser extension, and one that would prevent the "Make a Copy" button from properly re-initializing the Send edit drawer on web.

reviews.body:
It took me a while to grasp these code changes, but mostly because the PR title led me to believe we were hiding the copy button on disabled file Sends only. I hope it's OK I've updated the title to better reflect we are disabling the copy button on file Sends all-together, since they can't be copied (this was conveyed in the PR description, my fault for not reading it). 

❓ Would it make sense to add test coverage? Or would this only be testing the mock capabilities of Jest?

inline.body:
>(if Text Sends aren't allowed we'd have to turn the copy into a File Send)

This comment almost implies we might do this, I would re-word it to state more plainly that if text Sends are disallowed by policy we just won't allow a copy operation. 

If you agree, I would also update the comment in the other file.
